sections.heading: 第 壹 部 分 、 選 擇 題 （ 占 62分 ）
一 、 詞 彙 題 （ 占 10分 ）
說明︰第1題至第10題為單選題，每題1分。
二 、 綜 合 測 驗 （ 占 10分 ）
說明︰第11題至第20題為單選題，每題1分。
三 、 文 意 選 填 （ 占 10分 ）
說明：第21題至第30題為單選題，每題1分。
四 、 篇 章 結 構 （ 占 8分 ）
說明︰第31題至第34題為單選題，每題2分。
五 、 閱 讀 測 驗 （ 占 24分 ）
說明︰第35題至第46題為單選題，每題2分。
第 貳 部 分 、 混 合 題 （ 占 10分 ）
說明︰本部分共有1題組，每一子題配分標於題末。限在答題卷標示題號的作答區內作答，
第 參 部 分 、 非 選 擇 題 （ 占 28分 ）
說明：本部分共有二大題，請依各題指示作答，答案必須寫在「答題卷」標示題號之作答
一 、 中 譯 英 （ 占 8分 ）
說明：依題號將以下中文句子譯成正確、通順、達意的英文。每題4分，共8分。
二 、 英 文 作 文 （ 占 20分 ）
說明︰依提示寫一篇英文作文，文長至少120個單詞（words）。

items.stem: The mayor has such a ______ schedule that it takes weeks to arrange an interview with her.
Jane started as an ______ art designer, but now she has a professional studio of her own.

The teaching ______ at the famous high school soon attracted more than a dozen well-qualified
applicants.
Designed by a young engineer, the new product has created far more profit than ______ expected.
It has been confirmed that a balanced ______ of fruit and vegetables is a key element to good health.

As a shy boy afraid of making public appearances, Timmy ______ the thought of speaking before
large audiences.

To the newly-crowned winner of the piano competition, music is his life’s ______, which he has
devoted himself to whole-heartedly.

The drunk driver who shouted at passers-by and ______ them with glass bottles was quickly arrested
by the police.

There were so many people at the bus station that I had to ______ my way through the crowd to board
the bus in time.

Deadly shootings on US campuses have raised ______ concerns about how to prevent such tragic
incidents from happening again.

options.D:
an amazing local cuisine
